headline: Israeli leaders denounce Jewish terrorism after violent settler attacks across the West Bank
label: NEWS
caption:
Israeli political leaders have strongly condemned recent violent attacks by settlers in the West Bank.

According to the New York Times and the Guardian, Netanyahu rival Gadi Eisenkot condemned the arson attacks and Jewish terrorism following settler rampages on Palestinian villages.

Reuters reported that Gideon Saar also condemned the latest settler violence while noting enforcement efforts.

Meanwhile, according to Middle East Monitor, France has condemned the very serious attacks by violent settlers on several Palestinian localities.
